steps.note: Start the single-stage creation flow required for configuring a price-based auction.
Configure the event as a price-based auction.
Apply the first available pricing template.
Add one product for the competing bids.
Invite two vendors so the auction has two competing bidders.
Publish the auction before placing bids.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Confirm the trailing bid was accepted.

Open the trailing vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the live auction pricing round as the trailing vendor.
Check that the vendor-facing best-price indicator is shown.
